# Commands

Every command accepts `--json`. Per-command error codes: `graph describe commands --json`.

## graph apply

Apply change set documents (JSON or JSONL) from a file or stdin.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: none. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph apply FILE [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | yes | no | Path of the input, or - for stdin. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate every document without writing. |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe; single document only, else idempotency_key in each document. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph apply - --json` | Apply documents from stdin. |
| `graph apply <file> --dry-run --json` | Check a file without writing. |

## graph create

Create one entity of a type.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.create`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph create TYPE [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | term | yes | no | Type CURIE. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--set` | assignment | no | yes | attr=value, coerced by the attribute's datatype. |
| `--set-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | attr=<json>, a typed value. |
| `--edge` | assignment | no | yes | relation=<id>: an outgoing edge. |
| `--valid-from` | string | no | no | Start of validity: date or RFC 3339 timestamp. |
| `--valid-to` | string | no | no | End of validity: date or RFC 3339 timestamp. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph create <type> --set <attr>=<value>` | Create with one attribute. |
| `graph create <type> --set <attr>=<value> --edge <relation>=<id> --dry-run --json` | Preview the result. |

## graph find

Find entities by type, field filters and relations; paged.

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.find`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph find [OPTIONS]`

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | term | no | yes | Type CURIE, subtypes included. |
| `--where` | filter | no | yes | attr=value or attr:op=value (ne lt le gt ge contains prefix in exists). |
| `--rel` | string | no | yes | Outgoing relation, optionally =<id>[,<id>...]. |
| `--in-rel` | string | no | yes | Incoming relation, optionally =<id>[,<id>...]. |
| `--include-inactive` | flag | no | no | Include superseded and retracted entities. |
| `--sort` | string | no | yes | Field to sort by, optionally :desc. |
| `--limit` | integer | no | no | Page size, at most 500. |
| `--offset` | integer | no | no | Skip this many results. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read an earlier state (tx:<seq>); reserved. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `limit` | 500 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph find --type <type> --where <attr>=<value>` | Filter by a field. |
| `graph find --type <type> --rel <relation>=<id> --json` | Filter by a relation. |
| `graph find --type <type> --rel <relation>=<id>,<id> --json` | An edge to any of the listed entities. |

## graph link

Add an edge from one entity to another.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.link`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph link REF REL TARGET [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |
| `rel` | term | yes | no | Relation CURIE. |
| `target` | entity_ref | yes | no | Target id, alias or id suffix. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--qualifier` | assignment | no | yes | qualifier=value on the edge. |
| `--qualifier-json` | json_assignment | no | yes | qualifier=<json> on the edge. |
| `--target-rev` | integer | no | no | The target revision the edge refers to. |
| `--expect` | integer | no | no | Refuse unless the entity is at this revision. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph link <id> <relation> <id>` | Link two entities. |
| `graph link <id> <relation> <id> --qualifier <attr>=<value> --json` | Link with a qualifier. |

## graph lookup

Find entities by name: main, alternative and hidden labels; ranked candidates.

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.find`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph lookup TEXT [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | no | The name to look for. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | term | no | yes | Type CURIE, subtypes included. |
| `--match` | choice | no | no | Whole name, or names that start with the text. |
| `--ignore-accents` | flag | no | no | Also match with accents and other combining marks ignored. |
| `--include-inactive` | flag | no | no | Include superseded and retracted entities. |
| `--limit` | integer | no | no | Page size, at most 500. |
| `--offset` | integer | no | no | Skip this many results. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read an earlier state (tx:<seq>); reserved. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `limit` | 500 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph lookup <value>` | Entities named exactly so, any type. |
| `graph lookup <value> --type <type> --match prefix --json` | Names of one type that start with the text. |

## graph neighbors

Show the entities connected to one entity, up to three hops.

Kind: read. Surface: retrieve. Action: `read.traverse`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph neighbors REF [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rel` | term | no | yes | Only these relations. |
| `--direction` | choice | no | no | Edge direction. |
| `--depth` | integer | no | no | Hops, 1 to 3. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--as-of` | string | no | no | Read an earlier state (tx:<seq>); reserved. |

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `depth` | 3 |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph neighbors <id>` | Direct neighbors. |
| `graph neighbors <id> --rel <relation> --direction out --depth 2 --json` | Two hops along one relation. |

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.retract`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph retract REF [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--by` | entity_ref | no | no | The entity that retracts it. |
| `--expect` | integer | no | no | Refuse unless the entity is at this revision. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |

|---|---|
| `graph retract <id> --reason <value>` | Withdraw an entity. |

## graph unlink

Remove an edge by relation and target, or by edge id.

Kind: write. Surface: act. Action: `write.unlink`. Exit codes: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Usage: `graph unlink REF [REL] [TARGET] [OPTIONS]`

| Argument | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | entity_ref | yes | no | Full id, alias or trailing hex of the id. |
| `rel` | term | no | no | Relation CURIE. |
| `target` | entity_ref | no | no | Target id, alias or id suffix. |

| Option | Type | Required | Repeatable | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--edge-id` | string | no | no | The edge id instead of REL and TARGET. |
| `--expect` | integer | no | no | Refuse unless the entity is at this revision. |
| `--graph` | graph_ref | no | no | Graph name or id; else GRAPH_CLI_GRAPH or the pointer default. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | no | no | Validate and show the result without writing. |
| `--reason` | string | no | no | Why this change is made (required for supersede, retract). |
| `--idempotency-key` | string | no | no | Key that makes a retry safe. |

| Example | Summary |
|---|---|
| `graph unlink <id> <relation> <id>` | Remove the edge to a target. |
| `graph unlink <id> --edge-id <id> --json` | Remove one edge by id. |
